To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a numerical model of Nb3Sn strand is developed and validated with experimental data.

(1) A 3-D FE numerical model of a superconducting Rutherford cable is developed, (2) The model includes the strand as a bi-metallic component, (3) The strand is modeled using a homogenized composite behavior, (4) A representative volume element of the superconductor is used to identify homogenized material parameters, (5) The model is validated with experimental tests on superconductors.
a multiscale numerical model for Nb3Sn strand has been developed and validated.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of a numerical approach for multiscale 3-D modeling of Nb3Sn Rutherford cables, with the aim of studying the influence of the strand microstructure on its mechanical and magnetic behavior.
the development of a numerical model for the mechanical behavior of Nb3Sn conductors at the strand level.
the development of a numerical model for Nb3Sn strands, based on representative behavior laws.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a numerical model of Nb3Sn strand has been developed, based on representative behavior laws for all the components, including the superconducting filamental area.
the model developed in the present paper is able to reproduce the mechanical behavior of the Nb3Sn strands under monotonic and cyclic loads.
the proposed approach allows to model the mechanical behavior of Nb3Sn Rutherford-type cables at the strand scale.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed a multiscale modeling framework for the simulation of Rutherford cables and we have identified representative mechanical behavior laws for the strand model.

the proposed numerical model can reproduce the mechanical behavior of Nb3Sn strand at the scale of a strand and that this model can be used to simulate mechanical effects on the performance of Rutherford-type cable.
the proposed model is able to predict the behavior of Nb3Sn strands under tensile loads, and that the model can be used to build 3D cable-scale FE models.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a 3-D FE model at the strand scale can be developed to simulate the mechanical behavior of Nb3Sn strands.
the strand mechanical behavior is well reproduced using a simple model.
the strand model is able to predict the macroscopic mechanical behavior of the strand with good accuracy.
